summary:

Sources retrieved correctly (/discounted-package/, /advanced-modular-courses/), intent=courses. LLM judged Chennai-specific PSCRB fee not explicitly shown on those pages and declined — behaviour previously reported as grounded with a caveat in iteration 5. This is a soft LLM decision boundary, not a retrieval-side regression. Cached answer means retries will keep returning the same insufficient response unless the cache is cleared or a fresh cache key is used.
  - TestChatValueAddedCoursesListFormat::test_what_are_the_value_added_courses: intermittent insufficient on first parallel-xdist call, PASSED on retry (LLM variance).

Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.

action_items: OPTIONAL: consider clearing the chat answer_cache entry for 'PSCRB course at Chennai' (or adding a small cache TTL) so a one-off LLM 'insufficient' verdict does not permanently lock in a canned refusal. Not a hotel-number-leak issue.
OPTIONAL: consider persisting facts.source_urls order deterministically (already sorted alphabetically today — good). No fix needed.
critical_code_review_comments: ingestion.py HIMT_OWN_PAGE_ALLOWLIST/DENYLIST + _is_himt_own_page(url) — clean domain-scoped filter. Correctly denies /himt-nearby-accommodations/, /industry-reviews/, /testimonial/, /press-clippings/, /discounts-and-offers/ before extraction. Good.

ingestion.py _extract_facts_from_pages returns source_urls as a de-duplicated list — good for admin dashboard transparency. Consider sorting/canonicalising URLs to avoid trailing-slash duplicates (current output already looks clean).
ingestion.py: the legacy _extract_facts (single-string) is kept 'for backward compatibility' at line 313. If no other callsite uses it, mark it @deprecated or drop to reduce dead-code risk.

retrieval.py INTENT_URL_PATTERNS.contact now = ['/contact','/campus','/about-us','/our-faculty','/faq'] — good. /himt-nearby-accommodations correctly removed. DEPRIORITIZE_FOR_INTENT['contact'] should be verified to include /himt-nearby-accommodations so it can never surface as a top chunk for contact.

retrieval.py: consider adding /himt-nearby-accommodations to a global HARD_DENY_URLS list so it is dropped from retrieval entirely (not just deprioritised), matching the fact-extractor allow-list. Prevents any future intent (e.g., admissions/documents) from surfacing hotel-page chunks.

server.py chat cache: an LLM 'insufficient' answer gets cached with the same key as a grounded one — a single unlucky LLM run can lock in a canned refusal for that query forever. Consider skipping cache for status=insufficient, or setting a short TTL for negative cache entries.

Iteration 6 added two new classes: TestFactsBugFixHotelNumbers (5 tests: no-hotel-phones, HIMT campus number present, source_urls exclude denied pages, source_urls only HIMT-own, emails only HIMT domains) and TestChatContactNoHotelLeak (3 tests: 'HIMT contact number'/'HIMT phone number'/'HIMT contact details' — status=grounded, no hotel numbers in answer digits, sources exclude /himt-nearby-accommodations/, HIMT campus phone digits present). rca of the issue: BUG (hotel numbers served as HIMT contact) RCA: Prior fact extractor ran regex-based email/phone/address extraction on the FULL crawled corpus concatenated as one string. The crawl included /himt-nearby-accommodations/ (a list of nearby hotels for prospective students), so hotel front-desk phones ('044-26422297','9840730760','044-2661 2772','9789066624','9790966311','9566000511','9959511085') were extracted into facts.phones and injected into the LLM prompt for contact-intent queries. Fix (ingestion.py) introduces HIMT_OWN_PAGE_ALLOWLIST (/campus,/about-us,/faq,/our-faculty,/timeline-of-himt,/green-himt,/booking-procedures,/submission-procedure,/careers, homepage) and HIMT_OWN_PAGE_DENYLIST (/himt-nearby-accommodations,/industry-reviews,/testimonial,/press-clippings,/discounts-and-offers). _is_himt_own_page(url) enforces deny-then-allow ordering. New _extract_facts_from_pages(pages) iterates page-by-page, skips non-HIMT-own URLs entirely, and stores contributing source_urls for admin dashboard transparency. Additionally (retrieval.py), INTENT_URL_PATTERNS['contact'] no longer includes /himt-nearby-accommodations, and DEPRIORITIZE_FOR_INTENT gates 'contact'/'documents' intents against /himt-nearby-accommodations chunks so even if a hotel page ranks well by BM25/embedding, it will not appear as a top source for contact queries. Verified: facts.phones now contains ONLY '+91 98 404 000 00' (from /campus/); chat replies for 'HIMT contact number/phone number/contact details' contain ONLY that number; sources for those replies are [/faq/,/about-us/,/campus/] with no /himt-nearby-accommodations/. All 8 iteration-6 tests pass. All 7 hotel numbers absent from both facts and chat replies. Re-ingestion happened cleanly (latest_ingestion.status=completed, pages_indexed>0, chunks_indexed>0).
